Media.description:
The adventure is over but life goes on for an elf mage just beginning to learn what living is all about. Elf mage Frieren and her courageous fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land. But Frieren will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to understand what life means to the people around her? Decades after their victory, the funeral of one her friends confronts Frieren with her own near immortality. Frieren sets out to fulfill the last wishes of her comrades and finds herself beginning a new adventure…

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
Frieren is the protagonist of _Sousou no Frieren_ and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965)'s master. She was the Mage of the Hero Party and traveled alongside Hero [Himmel](https://anilist.co/character/184311/Himmel), Warrior [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen), and Priest [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) in a 10-year journey to defeat the Demon King. 

She was a magic prodigy at a young age, with an impressive quantity of mana, which caught the interest of [Flamme](https://anilist.co/character/219733/Flamme), a human wizard who taught her everything there is to know about magic and mana control until she passed away. Frieren persists in collecting magic knowledge no matter how trivial it may be.

Fern is the young mage apprentice of [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and accompanies her as a member of her party. She is an orphaned war refugee originally from the Southern Lands, later adopted by  [Heiter](https://anilist.co/character/184310/Heiter) and placed under Frieren's care.

Stark is a warrior who fights alongside [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) and [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern). After his village was attacked by demons, he fled and became [Eisen](https://anilist.co/character/184312/Eisen)'s apprentice. At Eisen's instruction, he joined Frieren's party as their vanguard.

Hero and Leader of the party that defeated the Demon King, and a self-proclaimed handsome narcissist. He cares about his friends and can't help but help those in need. He had a great influence on [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren), with whom he had adventures for 10 years.
A priest who is a part of the Hero's party. He later took care of [Fern](https://anilist.co/character/183965/Fern) until [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) arrived.
Dwarf warrior who was a part of the Hero's party, later became a mentor to [Stark](https://anilist.co/character/184313/Stark).
She lived a millennium before the story and was [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren)'s teacher.
A feared and powerful demon who served the Demon King.

Sein is a Priest from a small village in the Alt Woods. After [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) spotted his talent, he joined her group for a period of time with the goal of reuniting with his childhood friend Gorilla.

Aura is one of the Seven Sages of Destruction directly serving the Demon King. 

~!She later was killed by [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) after being commanded to kill herself using her own Auserlese.!~
He is an elf that Frieren's group meets in a cabin in the mountains. He's a monk and believed to be the last elf alive until meeting Frieren.

An elven mage who is said to possess knowledge about nearly every magic that exists. She was Flamme's master. She founded the Continental Magic Association around 20 years before Himmel's death. First-class mages get the privilege of meeting her and can ask for any magic they desire.
First-class mage who was a proctor for the first examination.
A third-class mage. Specializes in magic that makes her move at high speed. Treats [Denken](https://anilist.co/character/246058/Denken) as her grandfather.

Übel is a third-class mage. Was disqualified in an earlier examination due to killing a first-class wizard. Specializes in magic that allows her to copy the spells of people she can empathize with. Relies mostly on her intuition and is not bound by logical reasoning. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~

Denken is an imperial mage of the second-class. In his youth he belonged to an army but became an imperial mage after winning a power struggle. Often calm and calculating, however he still has a fire burning within despite his old age. He saw [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754/Frieren) as his motivation to become a mage. ~!Becomes a first-class mage after the examination.!~
Lawine is a third-class mage in the Second Party of the First Class Mage Examinations. She specializes in manipulating ice.

Kanne is a third-class mage who graduated from the Academy of Magic. She is childhood friends and classmates with [Lawine](https://anilist.co/character/293727), and the two entered the first-class mage exam together. In the first stage of the exam, she was paired with Lawine and [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754).
